items.title: Pug Horton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998
items.q: I played a small part in a Frank Sinatra movie

ctx.x: What circumstances brought you to the United States?

First of all I came to live in Canada in the ‘50s. I suppose in a way you could say that I was importing husbands but I’m not really. I came over with my first husband, who was an actor, and we went to live in Canada, and I was working for CBC, I was very active. I was doing a weekly television show, and not singing, I was acting. I was performing and acting as a showgirl and one thing or the other. Then I went back to England, after doing quite a lot of work, I played a small part in a Frank Sinatra movie, and I…
Were you aware of Bob Wilber’s music before you met?
